rules.text: Economic functions describe the service obtained from this product, not every service of its organization or underlying dependencies. Multiple labels are allowed.

Use supplied source record narrative/name/category only. Legacy symbols are context, not automatic facet truth, especially forced/not-used symbols. Empty lists mean unresolved/not evidenced, not proved absence.
For split children use only text explicitly about that child or common product function clearly supported by its name/category. Never inherit every bundled mechanism/residue/forced fit.
Organization IDs group corpus labels only. Never infer current chain, contract address or code revision from a brand, category or rank statement.
Identical independently proposed label sets are retained as provisional agreement, not empirical truth.

For differing sets retain their intersection provisionally; record the symmetric difference as unresolved and require targeted source evidence before promotion. This conservative rule applies to future rows as well.
